data.title: Peter Schiff Says Bitcoin Surprised Him By Holding Gains As He Still Expects New Lows
data.description: Gold advocate Peter Schiff admitted he’s surprised Bitcoin (BTC) has held onto gains that gold has given back, but still expects the cryptocurrency to fall to new lows.Schiff made the comments in an interview with Scott Melker on his podcast, The Wolf Of All Streets, published on Sunday.
